name: YT5

chatHistory.content:
Create a 38-second animated video at 4K (3840x2160) resolution, 25fps. The video uses a near-black background (#0A0A0A) throughout all scenes. All text uses Inter Semibold. The primary accent color is #00B3E3 (bright cyan blue). Secondary colors: #EF4444 (red), #2A2A2A (dark grey). Text color is white (#FFFFFF) unless specified otherwise.

The core visual motif across all scenes is a thin horizontal progress bar (approximately 4px tall, rounded ends). This shape is reused and evolved throughout the video to tell a continuous visual story.

---

SCENE 1 (0:00 - 0:03.22)

A single thin progress bar (#2A2A2A background, white fill animating left to right) appears horizontally centered on screen, vertically centered. It is 600px wide. It begins filling from left to right over 0.5 seconds. Before it completes, a second identical bar appears 12px below it and begins filling. Then a third. Bars keep spawning below each other, accelerating in spawn rate. By the 2-second mark, bars are spawning 10-15 per second. They fill the screen vertically from center outward (both up and down). Each bar fills at a slightly different speed. By the end of the scene, the screen contains roughly 120-150 bars stacked vertically with 12px gaps, all animating their fills at different rates. The overall effect is a dense, rhythmic, almost hypnotic wall of horizontal motion.

---

SCENE 2 (0:04.07 - 0:11.03)

All progress bars simultaneously freeze their fill animation and fade to dark grey (#1A1A1A fill, #0F0F0F background). This transition takes 0.5 seconds. The screen is now a static wall of dim, frozen bars.

One bar near the vertical center (offset slightly right and up from dead center to feel natural) transitions its fill color to #00B3E3 and resumes its fill animation, completing to 100%. Once complete, a small label fades in 8px to the right of the bar in Inter Semibold, 18px font size, white: "50K views". The label opacity animates from 0 to 1 over 0.4 seconds. Everything else stays frozen and dark. Hold this frame.

---

SCENE 3 (0:11.13 - 0:18.03)

The blue bar from Scene 2 begins to glow. A soft radial glow effect (#00B3E3 at 40% opacity, 20px blur radius) appears around the bar, expanding outward slowly over 1.5 seconds. The glow color shifts warmer, from cyan toward white (#FFFFFF at 30% opacity). The "50K views" label fades out.

Then the glow reverses. Over the next 3 seconds, the glow contracts and dims. The bar's fill color transitions from #00B3E3 to #2A2A2A. The bar becomes indistinguishable from all the other frozen grey bars. The screen is uniformly dark again. No text on screen.

---

SCENE 4 (0:18.03 - 0:24.20)

Same wall of frozen grey bars. A different bar (positioned in the lower-left quadrant of the grid) turns #EF4444 (red). Over the next 5 seconds, the red spreads to neighboring bars. The spread pattern: first the bars directly above and below turn red (0.3s delay each), then the bars next to those, radiating outward. The spread accelerates as it grows. Each bar transitions from grey to red over 0.2 seconds. By the end of the scene, approximately 60% of all bars on screen are red. The remaining bars are still grey. The red section is still actively growing when the scene cuts. No text on screen.

---

SCENE 5 (0:24.20 - 0:29.23)

Hard cut to fully empty black screen (#0A0A0A). 0.3 seconds of nothing.

A single thin horizontal line (2px tall, #00B3E3) draws itself from the left edge of the screen to the right edge over 1.2 seconds. It is vertically centered.

Once the line completes, text fades in above and below it simultaneously over 0.6 seconds:
- Above the line, centered: "YouTube Scraper" in Inter Semibold, 72px, white (#FFFFFF).
- Below the line, centered: "by Apify" in Inter Semibold, 32px, #00B3E3.

The blue line pulses once in brightness (opacity goes from 100% to 60% and back to 100% over 0.8 seconds). Hold.

---

SCENE 6 (0:29.23 - 0:38.01)

The "YouTube Scraper" and "by Apify" text slides up and scales down to sit at the top of the frame (top-center, 40px from top edge, text scales to 60% of original size).

The blue horizontal line stays vertically centered on screen.

From the left edge of the screen, small horizontal bars (same style as Scene 1, 200px wide, 4px tall, grey #2A2A2A fill) begin sliding across the screen from left to right at a steady pace. They enter at slightly varied vertical positions (scattered within 200px above and below the center line). Approximately 2-3 bars enter per second.

When a grey bar crosses the blue center line, one of two things happens:
- Most bars (roughly 70%) pass through unchanged and continue off the right edge of the screen, fading out.
- Some bars (roughly 30%) flash white for one frame as they cross the line, then change color to #00B3E3 and snap to a clean vertical stack on the right side of the screen (positioned at x: 80% of screen width). They stack downward with 16px gaps.

The first bar that gets caught has a small label appear next to it: "mention" in Inter Semibold, 16px, white. The second caught bar: "creator". The third: "data point". Labels fade in over 0.3 seconds.

Bars keep streaming through from the left for the duration of the scene. The stack on the right grows. The blue scanning line stays active. Final frame: the scanning line in the center, 5-6 caught bars neatly stacked on the right with their labels, grey bars still flowing through from the left. Hold for 1 second.
